outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
cohort: The study included 85 pregnant patients with symptomatic hydronephrosis (Grade >= 2) managed at a tertiary center between January 2020 and February 2025.
finding: Ultrasound-guided PCN is a safe and effective intervention for managing symptomatic hydronephrosis during pregnancy, demonstrating favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes comparable to conservative management.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates did not differ significantly between the PCN and conservative management groups.
